messages.en:
I heard that bigger cities
have been concerned with
the environment and stuff.
{07 15 00}Although {04 03 00} isn't
a smoggy metropolis, we
care about that, too!{02 00 00 03 04}
Really?
Yeah, I know.
messages.et:
Ma kuulsin, et suuremad
linnad on muretsenud
keskkonna ja muu pärast.
{07 15 00}Kuigi {04 03 00} pole
suitsune suurlinn, hoolime
ka meie sellest!{02 00 00 03 04}
Tõesti?
Jah, ma tean.

messages.en:
Did you know,{01 00 00 05 00} before people
had access to a variety of
clothes and accessories...
{07 14 00}...they wore flowers! Yeah,
even the boys.{01 01 00} {07 11 00}They just
held them in their teeth!
messages.et:
Kas sa teadsid,{01 00 00 05 00} et enne kui
inimestel oli valik riideid
ja aksessuaare...
{07 14 00}...kandsid nad lilli! Jah,
isegi poisid.{01 01 00} {07 11 00}Nad lihtsalt
hoidsid neid hambus!

messages.en:
Ugh.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 01 00} Of course we care!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 15 00}I mean, the town where my
father lives is filthy!
{07 06 00}I heard that this year, a
really stinky flower grew
there, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}. {01 00 00 05 00}Gross!
messages.et:
Uhh.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 01 00} Muidugi hoolime!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 15 00}Ma mõtlen, linn, kus mu
isa elab, on räpane!
{07 06 00}Kuulsin, et sel aastal
kasvas seal tõeliselt
haisev lill, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}. {01 00 00 05 00}Jälk!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Well,{01 00 00 05 00} hmm.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Really?!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 15 00}I think
we all should think more
about the environment!{02 00 00 05 06}
Yeah, yeah.
Do you?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Noh,{01 00 00 05 00} hmm.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Tõesti?!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 15 00}Ma
arvan, et peaksime rohkem
keskkonnale mõtlema!{02 00 00 05 06}
Jah, jah.
Kas sina?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}When you bury money,{01 00 00 05 00} you'd
best remember to plant it
in a place you can see it.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kui sa raha matad,{01 00 00 05 00} pea
meeles istutada see kohta,
kus sa seda näed.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}It's not just fruit that can
grow into a tree,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0b 00}DOUGHn't you want to learn
more? Is your INTEREST
growing?{02 00 00 0a 0b}
Tell me more!
Oh, that's RICH.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Mitte ainult puuvili ei
kasva puuks,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0b 00}Kas sa ei taha rohkem
teada? Kas su HUVI
kasvab?{02 00 00 0a 0b}
Räägi rohkem!
Oh, kes teist räägib!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}What?{01 00 00 0f 00} You don't care?
{01 00 00 0a 00}You're something else,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
What, are you so rich that
{07 0b 00}you don't worry about Bells
like the rest of us?
{07 15 00}I was just trying to help
you, and what do I get?{01 00 00 0a 00}
Attitude, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 02 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Mida?{01 00 00 0f 00} Sind ei huvita?
{01 00 00 0a 00}Sa oled alles tegelane,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Mis, kas sa oled nii rikas,
{07 0b 00}et sa ei muretse kellade
pärast nagu meie teised?
{07 15 00}Ma lihtsalt üritasin sind
aidata, ja mida ma saan?{01 00 00 0a 00}
Hoiakut, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 02 00 01}
